facts.fact: CPJ states that the state responded to post-election protests around the 29 October 2025 vote amid a five-day internet blackout.
CPJ states that in May 2025 authorities blocked access to X after the police account was hacked to announce the president's death, later saying the block was because X hosted pornography.
CPJ reports that ACT Wazalendo leader Janeth Rithe was arrested in June 2025 for telling supporters that the ruling party was running a police state.

note: Treason charge against journalist Godfrey Ng'omba and the arrests of Kusaga and others: the source does not say what they said, so no fact; the January 2025 ISP filtering rule is a power, not a cut.
